turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Order growth moderated but backlog remains elevated. Demand for power generation equipment tied to data center investment accelerated.
Backlog was stable. Book-to-bill was near one. Pricing power held versus cost. Dealer inventory ticked up slightly.
Is demand weakening or is this normal seasonality?
Demand is healthy overall; the moderation is seasonal. Data center-driven power demand is a new growth driver.
